title: Non Executive Director
description:
Formulate Strategy
Drive Member value
Collaborate with like-minded leaders for success
Are you looking to apply your leadership capabilities as a Non-Executive Director?  Ready to influence the savings and loans society industry in PNG?
Nambawan Savings & Loans Society (NSLS) seeks experienced and motivated Non-Executive Directors in the following:
ICT / Cybersecurity / Project Management / Business Continuity Planning
People & Culture / Customer Experience
About NSLS
Nambawan Savings & Loans Society (NSLS) aspires to grow and unlock further value for its growing membership.
Key Responsibilities:
Ensure members’ interests are always given priority in making decisions.
Contribute to formulating strategy to meet organisational objectives
Assist fellow Directors in setting the organisational values and standards & ensure that its obligations to its Members and the wider community are understood and fairly balanced at all times
Effective engagement at the most senior levels, as well as stakeholder communications & management experience
Understanding the importance of cultivating the desired company culture & the role of the board in setting the “tone from the top”.
Key Requirements:
Collaborative leader with suitable professional background with sound Governance experience;
Resident in PNG
Member of PNG Institute of Directors & Board experience will be considered favourably
Senior Management &/or leadership experience with minimum of 5+ years senior & executive management experience;
Minimum Degree in relevant field, MBA is highly desired;
Satisfy the Bank of PNG’s Fit & Proper assessment & not present any conflicts of interest
The organisation promotes diversity, and encourages skilled and experienced female candidates to apply
If you are interested in the position and wish to apply, you must submit:
a cover letter addressing key criteria of the role; and
an updated CV in MS Word format, outlining employment history, relevant experience & educational qualifications.
Please note:
We do not require copies of educational qualifications, transcripts & reference letters. These are only to be submitted upon request.
If you are well aligned to the skills and attributes required to support, nurture, and pivot a key member organisation then submit your application by clicking on the 'APPLY NOW' button and uploading a copy of your updated CV (Microsoft Word format) and a covering letter.
Applications must be received no later than 5:00 PM (PNG Standard Time) on Friday 31st October 2025.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
